content_data.project_title: Regional E-commerce Content Strategy & Engagement Hub
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive proposal for developing and implementing a scalable content strategy to enhance regional customer engagement, improve organic search visibility, and drive conversion rates across our e-commerce platforms.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 9 months, structured into three distinct phases of 3 months each.
objectives: Position the company as a trusted regional authority in its e-commerce niche.
Increase regional organic traffic by 25% within the first 6 months.
Improve customer engagement metrics (time on page, bounce rate) by 15% across key product categories.
deliverables: Content Distribution Strategy outlining channels and tactics.
Performance Tracking & Reporting Framework with defined KPIs.
Content Style Guide & Tone of Voice Document tailored for regional audiences.
Pilot Content Library (e.g., 10 blog posts, 5 product guides, 3 video scripts) for key regional segments.
